title: Bound on the number of pivots
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set, and let $C$ be a list of elements of $\nu$ and $R$ a list of linear equations over the field $\mathbb{F}_2$. The elimination procedure applied to $C$ and $R$ produces a pivot list whose length is at most the length of $C$.
